dataset-definition 0..*BaseDataset definition (model)
dataset-definition.id 1..1stringDataset identifier, e.g. 'ibd'.
dataset-definition.version 1..1stringSemantic version of this dataset definition.
dataset-definition.title 1..1stringHuman-readable name.
dataset-definition.description 0..1markdownWhat the dataset is for.
dataset-definition.cohort 1..1BackboneElementWho is in the Group.
dataset-definition.cohort.description 0..1markdownThe cohort in words, including anything the criteria cannot express.
dataset-definition.cohort.criteria 1..*BackboneElementA member filter. A patient must satisfy every criterion.
dataset-definition.cohort.criteria.resource 1..1codeFHIR resource type the criterion searches.
dataset-definition.cohort.criteria.param 0..*BackboneElementA FHIR search parameter.
dataset-definition.cohort.criteria.param.name 1..1stringSearch parameter name including modifier.
dataset-definition.cohort.criteria.param.value 1..1stringSearch value; same reference syntax as in a KPI definition.
dataset-definition.cohort.postFilter 0..*BackboneElementCohort logic that cannot be expressed as a FHIR search.
dataset-definition.cohort.postFilter.description 1..1markdownWhat is filtered, in words.
dataset-definition.cohort.postFilter.expression 0..1stringOptional formalisation.
dataset-definition.kpi 1..*stringId of a KpiDefinition whose data the export releases.
dataset-definition.include 0..*BackboneElementData the dataset releases that does not belong to any KPI, for example the Patient model with a filter on gender. Same shape as a KPI criterion.
dataset-definition.include.resource 1..1codeFHIR resource type.
dataset-definition.include.param 0..*BackboneElementA FHIR search parameter.
dataset-definition.include.param.name 1..1stringSearch parameter name including modifier.
dataset-definition.include.param.value 1..1stringSearch value; same reference syntax as in a KPI definition.
dataset-definition.include.element 0..*stringElements of the resource that must be released, as ElementName. Drives _elements and bounds the generated profile.

name: DatasetDefinition
title: Dataset definition (model)
description:
One dataset (for example IBD or COPD): the cohort that forms the Group, and the
KPI definitions whose data the export releases. The generator resolves a dataset
into a `Group` (cohort as bulk-data `member-filter`s) and a `Parameters`
(`_type`, `_typeFilter`, `_elements`), and renders the whole definition as a
readable page.
